correctness.rationale: For n>=2 maximal independent path configurations are binary words avoiding 11, 000 and endpoint 00. The exact 00,01,10 transfer T(z) with row v_2=(0,z_2,z_1) and column w=(0,1,1)^T counts precisely this set. Direct integer multiplication of the alternating seven-sign block gives B=[[1,0,0],[0,1,-2],[0,0,-1]] with Bw=-w for every prefix; this extends zero witnesses at n=2,3,5 by seven vertices. The unweighted maximal independent set count obeys a_n=a_(n-2)+a_(n-3) and has parity period seven, odd exactly at residues 0,1,4,6; an odd signed character sum cannot vanish. Independent brute-force enumeration and exact Walsh-Hadamard transforms n=2..10 agree with all residues and the transfer law, but the finite check is not used in place of the all-n proof.
residual_risks: Does not claim zero counts or inverse norms, only an all-frequency zero-free classification and explicit sign antisymmetry.
